resources.string: Share QR code
Import QR code
Share the current form, or import a CardTally configuration code using the camera or an image. The QR code contains login credentials. Share only with trusted devices.

This QR code is not encrypted. It contains the endpoint, username, login password and backup directory from the current form. Anyone with the image can decode it and access WebDAV within this account’s permissions. Share only with trusted devices, never publicly or in group chats.
Also share the backup encryption password

With both login credentials and the backup password, anyone with the QR code may download and decrypt financial backups. Backup encryption no longer protects this shared information. Generate only if you accept this risk.
Accept risk and generate
Cannot generate the QR code. Check the connection fields. If the content is too long, shorten the endpoint or directory, or exclude the backup password.
